title: Supply the correct form of the word given in each sentence.
description: Read the sentence and provide the correct form of the word in brackets.

questions.text: Folk dancers performed a __________ bamboo dance to welcome the international delegates.
The city organized a magnificent fireworks display for the New Year __________.
This classical folklore ballad was __________ composed in a quiet mountain monastery.
Several __________ artists established a studio in the old district to promote local handicrafts.
The growing __________ of international food fairs encourages cross-cultural understanding.
